beefs.title: Tirhut style temples
beefs.about: Undid revision 1375357154 by Purvanchal bhojpuriya (talk) Spooner’s survey included Saran, but I have not yet found evidence that he specifically classified a particular Saran temple as a “Tirhut-style temple.” Hence you are failing to understand the page is not about Spooner but Tirhuta (Maithili) Style temples
quotes: Undid revision 1375357154 by Purvanchal bhojpuriya (talk) Spooner’s survey included Saran, but I have not yet found evidence that he specifically classified a particular Saran temple as a “Tirhut-style temple.” Hence you are failing to understand the page is not about Spooner but Tirhuta (Maithili) Style temples

The cited work by Dr. David Brainerd Spooner on the Tirhut style of temples gives multiple examples from Saran and Champaran, and the citation provided in the article clearly mentions Saran. Saran was never part of the historical Tirhut Kingdom. Therefore, the fact that Spooner includes temples from Saran shows that his discussion is referring to the Tirhut Division during his study, not to the territory of the historical Tirhut Kingdom itself.
